verdict.rationale: The Division documents the registered-agent role as part of the entity record, with services to update or change the agent's name and address (docs-6, docs-8). It also offers Premier Business Services accounts for frequent filers that give staff access to a shared payment account for submitting filings (docs-37, supp-1), which suggests a channel for intermediaries filing on a company's behalf. However, nothing explicitly documents an authorized-provider or representative program that sanctions a third party to act for a company. missing for 10: explicit documentation of designee/authorized-filer or representative authorization, scope of what third parties may do on the entity's behalf, how a company grants or revokes that authority, independent corroboration.
